title: WhyNoIPv6 — Data Overview
description: What the collected data represents: dataset shape, confirmation coverage, adoption trends, crawler output, and campaign progress.

panels.title: Domains tracked
panels.description: Active (non-disabled) domains in the registry — the population every other number on this dashboard describes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS domains FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled

panels.title: Heroes
panels.description: Full IPv6: apex + www + nameservers + mail, and the site answers over an IPv6-only connection.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS heroes FROM domain WHERE classification = 'hero' AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Saints
panels.description: Heroes whose page resources (scripts, fonts, images) also load from IPv6-capable hosts — usable end-to-end IPv6-only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS saints FROM domain WHERE saint AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Sinners
panels.description: Confirmed no IPv6 on the apex at all (A record only).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS sinners FROM domain WHERE classification = 'sinner' AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Partial
panels.description: Some IPv6 but the hero bar not met (e.g. v4-only nameservers, broken v6 connect, or unverified dimensions).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS partial FROM domain WHERE classification = 'partial' AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Apex IPv6 adoption
panels.description: Share of domains with a confirmed apex verdict that publish AAAA — the headline adoption number.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE base_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(base_status), 0) AS adoption FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled

panels.title: Classification breakdown
panels.description: Every active domain lands in exactly one tier. unknown = never confirmed; inactive = apex has no A/AAAA at all (parked/empty zone).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'hero') AS hero, count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'partial') AS partial, count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'sinner') AS sinner, count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'inactive') AS inactive, count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'unknown') AS unknown FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled

panels.title: Confirmed coverage per dimension
panels.description: How much of the dataset each check has actually confirmed (non-NULL after anti-flap). Low resources coverage is expected while the registry re-confirms.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(base_status)::float / count(*) AS base, count(www_status)::float / count(*) AS www, count(ns_status)::float / count(*) AS ns, count(mx_status)::float / count(*) AS mx, count(conn_status)::float / count(*) AS conn, count(resources_status)::float / count(*) AS resources FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled

panels.title: IPv6 support per dimension
panels.description: Of the domains with a confirmed verdict on each dimension, how many are IPv6-supported. This is the adoption story per check.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE base_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(base_status), 0) AS base, count(*) FILTER (WHERE www_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(www_status), 0) AS www, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ns_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(ns_status), 0) AS ns, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mx_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(mx_status), 0) AS mx, count(*) FILTER (WHERE conn_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(conn_status), 0) AS conn, count(*) FILTER (WHERE resources_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(resources_status), 0) AS resources FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled

panels.title: Scan freshness
panels.description: When each active domain was last scanned. The daily cadence should keep nearly everything under 24h; a growing 48h+ bucket means the crawler is falling behind.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_checked_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS "< 24h", count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_checked_at <= now() - interval '24 hours' AND last_checked_at > now() - interval '48 hours') AS "24-48h", count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_checked_at <= now() - interval '48 hours') AS "> 48h", count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_checked_at IS NULL) AS never FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled

panels.title: IPv6 support per dimension over time
panels.description: Daily confirmed-state snapshot (stats_global_daily, written by the daily tick). Counts of domains supported per dimension.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, base_supported, www_supported, ns_supported, mx_supported, conn_supported, resources_supported FROM stats_global_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tiers over time
panels.description: Daily tier counts. Saints dropped to ~0 on 2026-07-25 when the confirmed resources columns were reset post D-fold fix; the rebuild curve is the re-confirmation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, heroes, saints, partial, sinners, inactive FROM stats_global_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: IPv6 gained vs lost (per day)
panels.description: Confirmed transitions from the changelog: dimensions that flipped to supported (gained) vs away from supported (lost). The net direction of the internet's IPv6 story.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1d') AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE new_value = 'supported') AS gained, count(*) FILTER (WHERE old_value = 'supported') AS lost FROM changelog WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Scans recorded (per day)
panels.description: Rows written to the scan hypertable (via the scan_daily_adoption continuous aggregate, ~1h behind). Roughly one scan per active domain per day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, sum(scanned) AS scans, sum(base_v6) AS base_supported, sum(conn_v6) AS conn_supported FROM scan_daily_adoption WHERE $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Mid-confirmation
panels.description: Domains with a pending value on any dimension — observed change waiting for the 3-consecutive-scans anti-flap confirmation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS pending FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled AND (base_pending IS NOT NULL OR www_pending IS NOT NULL OR ns_pending IS NOT NULL OR mx_pending IS NOT NULL OR conn_pending IS NOT NULL OR resources_pending IS NOT NULL)

panels.title: Changelog rows (total)
panels.description: All confirmed transitions ever recorded — the credibility surface, kept forever.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS changes FROM changelog

panels.title: Disabled domains by reason
panels.description: Rows hidden from public output: dead = confirmed non-existent DNS; delisted = dropped off the Tranco list past the grace window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(disabled_reason::text, 'unspecified') AS reason, count(*) AS domains FROM domain WHERE disabled GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Campaigns
panels.description: Active curated domain lists (government, banks, ISPs, …) imported from the campaign YAML repo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS campaigns FROM campaign WHERE NOT disabled

panels.title: Campaign domains
panels.description: Domain-campaign memberships (a domain can be in several campaigns).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS members FROM campaign_domain

panels.title: Campaign league table (latest snapshot)
panels.description: Per-campaign confirmed state from the latest daily snapshot. v6_ready = apex + nameservers supported, www supported or absent — the campaign readiness bar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.name AS campaign, s.domains, s.v6_ready, round(100.0 * s.v6_ready / nullif(s.domains, 0), 1) AS "ready %", s.heroes, s.partial, s.sinners FROM stats_campaign_daily s JOIN campaign c ON c.id = s.campaign_id WHERE s.day = (SELECT max(day) FROM stats_campaign_daily) ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Campaign readiness over time (top 10 by size)
panels.description: v6_ready share per campaign from the daily snapshots — the advocacy progress curve.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.day::timestamptz AS time, c.name AS metric, 100.0 * s.v6_ready / nullif(s.domains, 0) AS ready_pct FROM stats_campaign_daily s JOIN campaign c ON c.id = s.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.day::timestamptz) AND s.campaign_id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM stats_campaign_daily WHERE day = (SELECT max(day) FROM stats_campaign_daily) ORDER BY domains DESC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Resource-host registry
panels.description: Third-party hosts discovered on crawled pages (deduped globally), by confirmed AAAA status from the daily sweep. Feeds the saint rule and the resources dimension.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE aaaa_status = 'supported') AS supported, count(*) FILTER (WHERE aaaa_status = 'unsupported') AS unsupported, count(*) FILTER (WHERE aaaa_status IN ('no_record', 'not_applicable')) AS dead_ref, count(*) FILTER (WHERE aaaa_status IS NULL) AS unswept FROM resource_host

panels.title: Most-depended-on v4-only resources
panels.description: IPv4-only third-party hosts blocking the most domains from saint status — the highest-leverage advocacy targets.

targets.rawSql: SELECT host, dependent_count AS dependents FROM resource_host WHERE aaaa_status = 'unsupported' ORDER BY dependent_count DESC LIMIT 15
